svg.title: ULTRA-SATISFACTORY
svg.desc: A one-screen text-mode installer poster in black, cyan, white and gold. ULTRA fills the top in giant cyan block letters and SATISFACTORY sits under it in white ones, packed edge to edge inside a hazard-tape border with a name plate let into the top of the tape, reading SOFT CLEARANCE PRESENTS. Every stroke of ULTRA has a belt channel down its middle and small gold parts tick along it; more parts run along the gap between the two words and drop down between the letters of SATISFACTORY. A hexagon-and-cog emblem sits in the notch of the L. Underneath: a title strip reading THE UNOFFICIAL SATISFACTORY COMPANION APP, the line OBJECTIVES + ITEMS + BUILDINGS, ONE CLICK APART, a path field holding python -m streamlit run app/app.py, a twelve-cell progress bar that unpacks 140 items, 211 recipes, 477 buildings and 5 phases, and two tiny buttons at the bottom right: INSTALL and QUIT. Once the bar is full the status reads DONE. B.Y.O. GAME, then the path field swaps to lukexyz.github.io/ULTRA-SATISFACTORY and the status to NO INSTALL NEEDED.
